transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I’m here because… I’ve been having trouble keeping my answers straight. Like at work, someone asks when a ring repair will be ready, and I start talking about invoices, then somehow garden soil, then mortgage papers. I can see people losing track of me.
Have you been feeling unusually high or full of energy lately?
Not really… I don’t think so. I haven’t felt especially energetic or anything.
Have you had a strong belief that other people would say is not true?

I guess… yes. I know it sounds strange, but I’ve felt like some customers come in just to see if I’m behind on payments or something. They ask a lot about the new showroom, and my husband says they’re just being friendly, but… it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?
Sometimes. When the shop is quiet, I’ll hear… like a woman muttering my name from the polishing room. I go look, and no one’s there. It doesn’t happen all the time, but it feels real when it does.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual?
Not less sleep because I’m energized… I just can’t sleep. I lie there going over receipts and things in my head until two or three, then I’m up before dawn and can’t really settle again.
Have there been times when you felt so unusually confident or important that you believed you had special powers or a special mission?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve never felt like I had special powers or some mission. Nothing like that.
Have you had a period lately when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes… most days lately. I wake up and it’s just this flat, heavy sadness, like the color’s gone out of the house before I even get to the shop.
Have these experiences been going on for more than a month?
Yes… more than a month. It’s been going on since not long after we took on the business mortgage… almost two years, I guess.
Have the voices or suspicious thoughts ever happened during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

Yes… I think so. There was a stretch before I got this depressed where I was still teaching classes and working in the garden, but I’d hear things from the polishing room… and I kept feeling like customers were watching the business. It went on for several weeks.
At any time, have the voices or suspicious thoughts continued for at least two weeks when you were not feeling depressed?

Yes… there was a time before the depression really took hold. I was still running classes and doing the garden, but for several weeks I’d hear things from the polishing room, and I kept worrying customers were watching the business.
Have you found yourself talking much less than you used to, or feeling like it’s hard to get words out?
I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I’m not very talkative anyway, but I haven’t noticed being unable to get words out.
Have you ever felt that someone was putting thoughts into your mind?

Not… putting thoughts in, no. It’s more that I get convinced some customers are coming in to check if I’m going to miss payments. They ask too many questions about the new showroom, even though my husband says they’re just being friendly.
Do other people tell you that your speech is hard to follow because your thoughts jump from one topic to another?

Yes… a little. People don’t always say it outright, but I can tell I lose them. Like if someone asks when a ring repair will be ready, I’ll start answering and somehow I’m talking about invoices, then the garden soil, then mortgage papers… and I can see they’re not following me.
Have people said that your face seems less expressive or that you show less emotion than you used to?
Not that anyone’s said to me. I mean… I might be quieter sometimes, but I haven’t been told my face looks different or anything.
Have you ever felt that outside forces were controlling your thoughts or actions?

Not controlling me, exactly. It’s more… I get convinced certain customers are there to check on me, like whether I’m going to miss payments, because they keep asking about the new showroom. My husband says they’re just being friendly, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Have the voices and suspicious beliefs been present continuously for at least one month?
Yes… it’s been longer than a month. It started maybe a year and eight months ago, the voices and the worries about customers watching us.
Before these voices and suspicious thoughts began, had you been diagnosed with a neurological illness or brain injury?
No… not that I know of. I haven’t had anything like that diagnosed.
Since these problems began, has it become harder for you to manage your work or day-to-day responsibilities than it used to be?

Yes… it has. I’ve had to cut back on custom pieces because I’m missing repair deadlines, and sometimes I lose my place when I’m talking with clients. My husband checks the invoices now too, which… I used to handle that myself.
Have you been less motivated to do things than you used to be?

Yes… I guess I have. I used to really like looking for old clasps and thinking up little jewelry classes, but lately I just sort of stare at the trays and… it feels like there’s no point starting anything.
During this time, have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes… I think so. Most mornings I wake up with this flat, heavy sadness, like… the color’s already drained out of the house before I even get to the shop.

A major depressive episode is also clearly present, and psychotic symptoms were explicitly present for several weeks, including at least 2 weeks, outside of depressive periods.
